newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Virgin among bidders for S.Africa's Sun Air -paper.
newsitem.headline: Virgin among bidders for S.Africa's Sun Air -paper.

text.p: Richard Branson's Virgin Atlantic is among more than 10 bidders for soon-to-be privatised South African airline Sun Air, Business Report newdspaper said on Friday.

Quoting an industry source, the paper said advisers BOE NatWest and Moseneke & Partners had received more than 10 offers for the airline by Thursday's deadline for the submission of pre-qualification bids.

Virgin is bidding in conjunction with Bhekilanga, a consortium of six black empowerment groupings. Rethabile, another black empowerment consortium, has also submitted a bid. The indentity of other interested parties was not known.
The government is selling 100 percent of the airline, formerly the carrier for the nominally independent homeland of Bophuthatswana, as part of its privatisation drive.
The sale will comprise three stages -- pre-qualification, submission of non-binding offers and final offers/completion.
An announcement on which bidders have been shortlisted to move to the next stage is expecte next week.
